description: This file defines a class implementing a user turn stop strategy based on transcription frames, handling speech detection and transcription results asynchronously.

classes.name: TranscriptionUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that stops user turn based on transcription activity and VAD frames, managing asynchronous tasks and internal state.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the strategy with optional timeout and other parameters.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the strategy.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up the strategy with a task manager, creating an internal task.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up the strategy, cancelling internal tasks.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames to update internal state based on frame type.

methods.name: _handle_vad_user_started_speaking
methods.description: Handles VAD start speaking frame, marking user as speaking.

methods.name: _handle_vad_user_stopped_speaking
methods.description: Handles VAD stop speaking frame, marking user as not speaking and possibly stopping user turn.

methods.name: _handle_interim_transcription
methods.description: Handles interim transcription frames, marking interim results seen.

methods.name: _handle_transcription
methods.description: Handles final transcription frames, appending text and resetting interim results.

methods.name: _task_handler
methods.description: Asynchronous loop monitoring transcription activity to trigger user turn stop.

methods.name: _maybe_trigger_user_turn_stopped
methods.description: Triggers user turn stopped event if conditions are met.
